purpose: Descriptive concentration of evaluation target-weight mass across already exposed chains; no model comparisons, new scoring, calibration or gate changes.
allowed_stats: Column0 only (sum of absolute clipped target weight), verify candidate/reference equal. No prediction-derived moments or correlations.
metadata_only: Decode row_group from valid_targets.npz; chain/split/fold/pure/row_group from chain_folds.npz, exact historical hashes. Never decode y/mask, no raw prediction files.
outputs: For pooled and fixedfolds0/1, pertarget: chaincount, sequencecount, totalweight, maxchainshare, top10chainshare, sumsqshares and reciprocal(weight-concentration equivalent count).
interpretation: Reciprocal squared mass shares is a descriptive concentration statistic, not the effective sample size or standard error of weighted Pearson. No independent-sample claim for chains.
resources: Local NumPy one thread; one remote metadata-only read pinnedCPU37 one thread, timeout30s; noGPU, noCPU18/22.
